text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — quick UI review for the new metrics chart in Console. Thinking about legend affordances, axis labels, and outlier display.
Jamal Ortiz: +1. main things I noticed: legend items low contrast on gray bg, toggle state unclear when multiple series hidden.
Elena Petrova: Agree. Also axis unit shorthand 't' vs 'traces' is ambiguous. Should we standardize to k/M/G or full units on hover?
Maya Chen: Proposal: show compact units on the axis (k, M) but full unit in tooltip and aria-label. e.g., `12.3k traces`.
Sam Wu: For outliers I re-ran the sample dataset and saw one spike that flattens the y-scale. Options: inset zoom, clamp at 99th percentile, or log scale.
Elena Petrova: My vote: default clamp to 99th percentile with a small "show outliers" toggle. Also add an inset sparkline showing the full range so context isn't lost. Keeps main chart readable.
Jamal Ortiz: Need to be careful with smoothing: it's great for trend view but misleading for peak detection. Add a `smoothing: true/false` toggle and ensure smoothing is off in raw-data export.
Design System Bot: Reminder: color pairs must meet 4.5:1 for text labels and 3:1 for non-text per WCAG. Current orange/white legend fails contrast.
Maya Chen: Good call. I'll update tokens: orange -> #D75A00 (contrast 4.6:1 on white). Can someone validate with the contrast checker?
Sam Wu: Quick chart config I prototyped:
```
{ "yUnit": "traces", "yCompact": true, "outlierHandling": "clamp_99", "outlierInset": true, "smoothing": false }
```
Elena Petrova: Copy nits for tooltip: change `count` to `traces` and prefix values with unit when compacting. Also add aria-labels for series toggles: `Toggle Series: <name>, currently hidden|visible`.
Jamal Ortiz: Accessibility nit: keyboard focus visible on legend items, and pressing Space toggles. Also ensure the legend is in DOM even when collapsed (for screen readers).
Maya Chen: Action items: Maya to update color tokens and legend styles; Sam to add clamp/inset and config flag; Elena to draft tooltip and aria copy; Jamal to wire keyboard interactions. Back on this Wednesday for final signoff. :thumbsup:
Sam Wu: I'll add unit tests for clamp behavior and smoothing toggles.
Design System Bot: Deploy preview available at https://preview.redwood-inference.com/metrics/123 — test with NVDA and VoiceOver.
Maya Chen: Thanks team! closing thread.
